summary: A future in Quote mode, then Depth on top: the feed moves the instrument from mode 2 to mode 3 at mStock and back; a full packet gives the Quote frame its OI and the Depth frame its book; a Quote packet has no OI to send.

deviations.reason: mStock's Quote packet (123 bytes) carries no open interest; the web sends oi 0 for it (mstock_adapter.py:369, quote_data.get('oi', 0) over the parser's oi: 0 placeholder, mstockwebsocket.py:211), an invented zero a client reads as a real OI. The desktop leaves oi out until a packet has carried one, and then sends the last OI the instrument's full packet carried on this connection (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs merges by presence), never a 0 it was not sent.
deviations.ref: decisions 2026-11-09: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out; web openalgo#2376

deviations.reason: With Depth open on the instrument the web's Quote topic carries the full packet's dict, its circuit limits included (mstock_adapter.py:186-210, 425-426); the desktop's Depth frame now carries them, its Quote frame cut from the same full packet does not. Lead decision (C08): lower-mode frames of a one-dict broker carry the richer packet's keys as the web sends them; lane wire's step 2 (the one-dict fold) brings it.

With Depth open on the instrument the web's Quote topic carries the full packet's dict, its circuit limits included (mstock_adapter.py:186-210, 425-426); the desktop's Depth frame now carries them, its Quote frame cut from the same full packet does not. Lead decision (C08): lower-mode frames of a one-dict broker carry the richer packet's keys as the web sends them; lane wire's step 2 (the one-dict fold) brings it.

With Depth open on the instrument mStock sends full packets, and the web's Quote topic carries the full packet's normalised dict, its book included (mstock_adapter.py:186-210, normalised by the packet's own mode). Lead decision (C08): lower-mode frames of a one-dict broker carry the richer packet's keys as the web sends them; lane wire's step 2 (the one-dict fold) brings it.
